semantics.name: id
semantics.description: Stable, unique atom identifier, conventionally 'atom-<slug>'.

semantics.name: title
semantics.description: Short, descriptive title for the atomic knowledge unit.

semantics.name: five_wh_one_plus
semantics.description: The single 5WH1+ question this atom answers: one of what, why, how, how_not, when, where, for_whom.

semantics.name: answer
semantics.description: The curated raw answer to the selected 5WH1+ question, written as one stable knowledge unit.

semantics.name: tags
semantics.description: Namespaced semantic tags used for retrieval and grouping, each in the form namespace:value (e.g. system:deskops, topic:templates). Tags do not encode lifecycle, relations, evidence, or materialization.

semantics.name: provenance
semantics.description: Optional URL or path to the authoritative source of this atom's knowledge. Used for traceability and provenance tracking.

semantics.name: id
semantics.description: Stable id, conventionally 'cmd-<system>-<dashed-command-path>'.

semantics.name: system
semantics.description: System/tool that owns this command (e.g. sldb, kgdb).

semantics.name: command_path
semantics.description: Full command path as invoked, space-separated (e.g. 'stores init').

semantics.name: synopsis
semantics.description: One-line help string; the argparse `help=` for this command.

semantics.name: purpose
semantics.description: Why the command exists and what problem it solves.

semantics.name: how_it_works
semantics.description: What the command does step by step and how it uses the store/graph.

semantics.name: arguments
semantics.description: Newline list of arguments, one per line as '<name> | required|optional | <help>', mirroring argparse.

semantics.name: usage
semantics.description: Concrete example invocation(s) of the command.

semantics.name: tags
semantics.description: Namespaced semantic tags for retrieval and grouping.

semantics.name: provenance
semantics.description: Path to the code that implements this command (parser + handler).

semantics.name: title
semantics.description: Relation instance title shown as the H1 heading.

semantics.name: source_id
semantics.description: Export id of the source document, Model:name (store:Model:name for a linked store).

semantics.name: target_id
semantics.description: Export id of the target document, Model:name (store:Model:name for a linked store).

semantics.name: relation_type
semantics.description: Vocabulary token naming the relation type; must match a tracked RelationTypeDoc name.

semantics.name: condition
semantics.description: sldb --where predicate for this edge only; empty inherits the type's condition.

semantics.name: notes
semantics.description: Optional markdown notes about this specific authored edge.

semantics.name: title
semantics.description: Relation type title shown as the H1 heading.

semantics.name: name
semantics.description: Vocabulary token for the relation type, e.g. booked_by or implements; the relation_type every edge carries.

semantics.name: direction
semantics.description: Directed edges read source->target only; undirected edges are materialized in both directions.

semantics.name: cardinality
semantics.description: How many targets one source may have and how many sources one target may have; validated at ingest.

semantics.name: axis
semantics.description: Predicate axis this relation answers (WHAT, WHY, HOW, WHERE, WHEN, PROVENANCE, ...); registered as an sldb predicate so prose links share the vocabulary.

semantics.name: source_types
semantics.description: Node classes allowed as source: model names (with inheritance) or kgdb node types; empty means any.

semantics.name: target_types
semantics.description: Node classes allowed as target: model names (with inheritance) or kgdb node types; empty means any.

semantics.name: condition
semantics.description: sldb --where predicate every edge of this type inherits unless the RelationDoc overrides it; may name fields of the subject in braces, e.g. capacity >= {party_size}.

semantics.name: description
semantics.description: Markdown section describing the meaning and intended use of the relation type; it is the verb's motive in a lexicon.

semantics.name: id
semantics.description: Stable id, conventionally 'surface-<system>-<surface>'.

semantics.name: system
semantics.description: System/tool that owns this surface (e.g. sldb, kgdb).

semantics.name: surface
semantics.description: Surface/command-group name as exposed by the CLI (e.g. stores, docs).

semantics.name: purpose
semantics.description: Why this surface exists and what capability it groups.

semantics.name: how_it_works
semantics.description: How the surface operates and how its commands relate.

semantics.name: commands
semantics.description: Newline list of leaf command names in this surface.

semantics.name: tags
semantics.description: Namespaced semantic tags for retrieval and grouping.

semantics.name: provenance
semantics.description: Path to the code that implements this surface (parser + handlers).

semantics.title: has_model
semantics.name: has_model
semantics.description: The store registers this model.

semantics.title: has_document
semantics.name: has_document
semantics.description: The model has this document as an instance.

semantics.title: has_section
semantics.name: has_section
semantics.description: The document contains this section.

semantics.title: tagged_as
semantics.name: tagged_as
semantics.description: The model, document or section carries this semantic tag.

semantics.title: semantic_parent
semantics.name: semantic_parent
semantics.description: This tag is a child of that tag in the semantic DAG.

semantics.title: semantic_equivalent
semantics.name: semantic_equivalent
semantics.description: This local tag maps to that global tag across linked stores.

semantics.title: has_field
semantics.name: has_field
semantics.description: The model declares this field; the field node carries its type and description.

semantics.title: extends
semantics.name: extends
semantics.description: The model inherits from that model (base_models); instances of the source are instances of the target.

semantics.title: applies_to_source
semantics.name: applies_to_source
semantics.description: Instances of this model may be the source of edges of this relation type: the verbs a class can be subject of.

semantics.title: applies_to_target
semantics.name: applies_to_target
semantics.description: Instances of this model may be the target of edges of this relation type.

semantics.title: names
semantics.name: names
semantics.description: The anchor (an alias word) names this model, field, relation type or document.
